Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Possessed Skaab and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
